data.gender_notes: Fairoz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-r-z' which means 'to be victorious' or 'to overcome'. This name carries a strong and inspiring message for those who seek success and triumph in their lives. The name Fairoz carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fairoz usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Fairoz was the title given to the Sultan of Delhi, Muhammad Shah, during his reign from 1590 to 1605 CE. During his rule, he extended the Mughal Empire's territories and consolidated his power. He is also known for commissioning the construction of the tomb of Emperor Humayun.

Another notable figure named Fairoz was the wife of the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan (r. 1628-1658 CE). She was the mother of his cherished son, Prince Dara Shikoh. The name Fairoz means 'delight' or 'joy' in Persian.
